leadText: A Café Master (Japanese: マスター Master) is a type of Pokémon Trainer introduced in Generation VIII. They are owners of Battle Cafés located throughout Galar. They use Pokémon related to sweets, most of which are Pokémon. In Battle Cafés, Café Masters will face the in a Double Battle whenever they use more than one Pokémon, and they can be rematched once a day. In the , Café Masters specialize in - and Pokémon.
